newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF Bank cuts SKW Trostberg to hold.
newsitem.headline: BHF Bank cuts SKW Trostberg to hold.

text.p: BHF Bank said on Friday it had cut its recommendation for German specialty chemicals group SKW Trostberg to hold from buy and had reduced its earnings per share estimates.
BHF analyst Ronald Koehler said he cut the group's 1996 EPS to 2.25 marks from 2.65 marks, slashed the 1997 EPS to 2.90 marks from 3.10 marks and reduced the 1998 EPS to 3.70 marks from 3.90 marks.
The company on Friday morning released nine-month results, which Koehler said were slightly disappointing, partly due to ongoing weakness in the construction sector.
